restrictions: Exactly sha1-r80-prefix-v1: fixed standard IV, all 80 prefix rounds on every padded block, standard padding and feed-forward, full 160-bit output.
One batch of 2^80 independent uniform 32-byte messages from fresh model random words. No PRNG, output-uniformity or SHA-1 random-function premise.
Two arrays of 64-byte records and 65536 word counters; ten stable 16-bit least-significant-digit radix passes; full adjacent distinct-message check and at most two verification hashes.

Worst-case total time includes one compression per sampled message, all other work priced at 1/1982 per word operation, every failed draw, bucket initialization, memory traffic, code setup and final verification.
Peak memory below 2^88 bytes is a theoretical RAM bound, not a physically executable resource claim. Memory does not contribute to the selected time score.
data_log2 bounds complete message evaluations; preprocessing_log2 uses target-compression equivalents; advice_log2_bytes=0 bounds actual zero advice by one byte because the schema excludes log2(0).

Generic analytic baseline improvement only: no actual collision, full-scale execution, new SHA-1 weakness, reproduction of a published differential attack or improvement over the nominal exponent 80 is claimed.
